entries.scene: The narrow EXTERIOR courtyard and side passage of the Guest House in Portable Ops. Keep the dark green evening palette and a strip of dusty gravel beside square worn paving stones. Side-on along the exterior wall; preserve a flat foreground path while the reference ramp remains behind it. Do not invent a luxurious manor or hotel reception.
